name: Stat
summary: One number with its label, its change since the last period and a short hint: a KPI.
useWhen: A dashboard row of key numbers: active users, revenue, failed payments
One headline number at the top of a report or a detail page, with how it moved
A count that people compare with a target or the last period
avoidWhen: Many numbers people compare row by row
A trend over time that people read point by point
A number that is a setting people change
A small count on a nav item or a tab

insteadUse.A trend over time: a chart (wave 3), with Stat above it for the latest value

label.description: What the number counts, in sentence case: Active users.

value.description: A number is formatted with Intl in the Theme language with Western digits and the format options. A node (No data) is drawn as is.

format.description: Intl.NumberFormat options for a numeric value: currency, unit, compact notation.

delta.description: The change since the last period. A number sets the trend from its sign and is drawn as its absolute value with deltaFormat (0.12 is 12%). A change that rounds to zero in that format is flat. A delta that is not a finite number is not drawn. A node is drawn as is and needs trend.

deltaFormat.description: Intl.NumberFormat options for a numeric delta.

trend.description: Default from the sign of a numeric delta. Sets data-trend on the root (up, down or flat) and the arrow icon.

tone.description: The color of the change. Default success when up, danger when down, neutral when flat. Set it when down is good: costs, errors, churn. Only stamped when there is a change.

hint.description: A short line under the value: Since last month.

icon.description: A system icon name or a node at the end of the label line. Decorative, hidden from assistive tech.

size.description: The size of the value: font.size 2xl, 4xl and 6xl.

loading.description: Draws a placeholder block for the value, sets aria-busy and data-loading, hides the change.

loadingLabel.description: What screen readers hear while loading. جار التحميل under an Arabic Theme.

trendLabels.description: Overrides the trend words: { up, down, flat }. Default Up, Down, No change, or ارتفاع، انخفاض، بدون تغيير.

a11y.role: None: a div with text. Read in order: label, value, change, hint.
a11y.announce: The change is read with its trend word first: Up 12%. Value changes are not announced, so a page of refreshing KPIs stays quiet. While loading, aria-busy is set and the value says loadingLabel.
notes: The trend is never color alone (WCAG 1.4.1): an arrow or a bar icon draws it and a visually hidden word says it.
data-trend on the root carries up, down or flat: a valued state, listed in states as data-trend=up|down|flat so the contract suite checks its values.
Numbers use tabular figures, so a refreshing value does not shift its neighbours.
Under forced colors the loading block keeps a CanvasText border.
The trend icons (trend-up, trend-down) do not mirror in right to left layouts, like chart glyphs; the trend word carries the meaning.

en.label: A noun phrase in sentence case: Active users, Revenue this month. No colon.
en.hint: Say what the change compares with: Since last month.
en.empty: No data, with a hint that says when it will show.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: المستخدمين النشطين، الإيرادات.
ar.digits: Western digits, through Intl with the latn numbering system. Currency SAR shows ر.س.

react.note: number-roll plays through the Web Animations API on duration.roll and ease.reveal when a numeric value changes after the first paint; opacity only under reduced motion. Numbers go through a private formatStatNumber until packages/shared/src/number.ts (order 1.2.5) lands.

native.note: Same props; number-roll through Reanimated in wave 2.

styles.studio: Bright value on the black body, muted label and hint; the change in the state text colors.
styles.desk: Same layout in Instrument Sans with display tracking on the value.
styles.neutral: Same layout on the Neutral tokens; no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: A green number with no arrow or word
mistakes.right: delta with its trend: the icon and the hidden word say up or down

mistakes.wrong: Errors went down, shown in red
mistakes.right: tone success on a metric where down is good

mistakes.wrong: A preformatted string like 48.2K for a number
mistakes.right: value as a number with format { notation: 'compact' }, so the language sets the digits

mistakes.wrong: A live region around a refreshing KPI
mistakes.right: No announcement; the page announces a change people asked for
